item.title: China calls for political solution to end US-Israeli war on Iran
item.description: Iran and China stress diplomacy and political solutions to end US-Israeli aggression and restore stability across West Asia.

item.title: Iran-Russia trade expansion hinges on resolving private sector hurdles: Official
item.description: A trade official emphasizes the need to translate strategic bilateral agreements and the EAEU Free Trade deal into actionable logistics, secure payment mechanisms, and joint value chains to capture a larger share of the Eurasian market.

item.title: Iran, Armenia form eight working committees to expand trade, transit and energy ties
item.description: A senior Iranian official says the talks cover border infrastructure, customs capacity, and electricity transmission.

item.title: Iran to pursue ‘offensive’ military doctrine, unrestricted response to aggression: Army
item.description: Akraminia said the implementation of the latest directives issued by the Leader of the Islamic Revolution is being pursued seriously.

item.title: IRGC Navy announces halt to oil smuggling via illegal Strait of Hormuz passage: Report
item.description: A report by Fars News Agency, citing an informed source in the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) Navy, said no unauthorized vessels managed to enter the illegal passage overnight following the destruction of the navigation systems.

item.title: Iran’s Two-Day Plan most rational path to restoring Hormuz security: Foreign Ministry
item.description: Iran says its Two-Day Plan is the “most rational” offer currently available for resolving the situation surrounding the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: US strikes on Qeshm Island caused no damage to residential areas, vital infrastructure: Official
item.description: An Iranian official says US strikes on Qeshm Island caused no damage to residential, commercial or vital infrastructure.

item.title: Shanghai Forum: The Iran-China economic axis on a $300 billion horizon
item.description: More than 300 Iranian and Chinese officials and business representatives gatherin Shanghai to advance a $300 billion investment agenda spanning energy, industry, infrastructure, technology and trade despite American sanctions.

item.title: Americans, regional nations 'sick and tired' of Israel duping US into ‘forever wars’: Iran FM
item.description: Iran’s foreign minister says people in the US and West Asia are fed up with Israel dragging Washington into forever wars.

item.title: Neither Democrats’ victory nor Republicans’ rule will change Iran’s calculations: Leader’s advisor
item.description: A senior advisor to the Leader of the Islamic Revolution says changes in US political leadership will not alter Iran’s strategic calculations.

item.title: Iran Navy: Another violating tanker set ablaze after hitting mine in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The Iranian Navy says a tanker caught fire after striking a mine in the Strait of Hormuz on Sunday.

item.title: Araghchi: Time for US to accept Iran's proposal or ‘choose war’
item.description: Iran's foreign minister says Tehran's two-day proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz still stands, but warns of a severe response to any new aggression.

item.title: UNICEF warns of worsening winter risks for children, displaced people in Gaza
item.description: UNICEF has warned of the escalating risks threatening the lives of children and the displaced in the Gaza Strip.

item.title: London protesters support activists on trial over Israel-linked arms factory break-in
item.description: Supporters say the prosecution criminalizes direct action against weapons made in Britain and used by the Israeli military in the Gaza genocide and beyond.

item.title: Activists camp at Rome landmark over housing crisis
item.description: Housing activists stage a tent protest in the Italian capital, denouncing soaring rents, evictions, and real estate speculation amid the country’s deepening housing crisis.
